stem: Meera's family in Pune buys vegetables from a nearby farmer's market instead of vegetables shipped from another state. Her teacher says this reduces 'food miles' and is better for the family and the environment. Which statement correctly explains why?

options.text: Food miles measure how far Meera travels to the market, so buying local food does not change the food miles of the vegetables.
Food miles are the distance food travels from producer to consumer, so local vegetables travel a shorter distance, lowering transport cost and fuel pollution.
Food miles stop counting once the food reaches the shop, so shipped vegetables and local vegetables have the same food miles.
Local vegetables have fewer food miles only because they look fresher, so cost and pollution are not affected.

teacher.key_rationale: Food miles are the full producer-to-consumer distance; locally grown vegetables travel less, so transport fuel use, cost, and pollution fall. Option A reverses the definition (distance travelled by the person), C wrongly truncates the scope at the shop, and D uses a surface feature (fresh appearance).
